package main

// The genesis-link spelling corpus (RB9-F6 TS port, step 3; the validator review V-P's adversarial list as Go-judged cases): the offline walk requires the
// genesis link of every evidence 2.1 document, and Go reads the member through encoding/json - its name matches case-insensitively, a duplicate key takes
// the LAST value, a null leaves a pointer nil, a value of another type is an error. The corpus gives every base document that carries a genesis link (the
// '-g' siblings of the xpartition suites and of certify1, and the document that carries a foreign chain's own link) each of these spellings of it:
//
//	value        delete, null, "", {}, [], 0, false, true, "00", "deadbeef"; an object with empty fields, entries null, a null step, no steps (anchor = start),
//	             start altered, anchor altered
//	name         genesislink, GenesisLink, GENESISLINK (the only spelling), genesis_link, 'genesisLink ' (a trailing space)
//	misplaced    the member moved to the top of the document, into evidence.check
//	duplicate    the good link then null / "" / {} (both spelled genesisLink and GENESISLINK), null / "x" / an altered link then the good link
//	links        the link taken out of genesisLink and put in links: null, [], [that link], [{}], with and without genesisLink
//	version      evidence.version null, "", "2.10", "2.1 " (a trailing space), "2.0" (the 2.0 reader does not read the members)
//
// A case is a list of byte edits of the base file, judged from the text as every byte corpus is; the file is read by the same consumer (helpers/s3-bytes.ts).
//
//	XTS_SHARD=<i>/<n> ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> genesisspell      (the whole corpus is a few thousand cases: one process is enough)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

func genesisBases(fixtures string) ([]string, error) {
	var bases []string
	add := func(rel, dir string) error {
		ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(fixtures, dir))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, e := range ents {
			n := e.Name()
			if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(n, "-g.json") {
				continue
			}
			bases = append(bases, rel+n)
		}
		return nil
	}
	for _, s := range []string{"xpartition2", "xpartition2b", "xpartition3", "xpartition3b", "xpartition4", "xpartition5"} {
		if err := add(s+"/", s); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if err := add("../s3-rb9k/xpartition6/", "../s3-rb9k/xpartition6"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := add("../s3-f5/certify1/", "../s3-f5/certify1"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// the foreign chain that carries its own self-consistent link: a document with a link that does not hold, as a base of the spellings
	bases = append(bases, "../s3-f5/certify1/continuous-chain-of-another-incarnation-with-its-own-link.json")
	return bases, nil
}

type spellCase struct {
	name  string
	edits []ByteEdit
}

func spellCases(doc []byte) ([]spellCase, error) {
	w := &objWalker{b: doc}
	w.value(0, "", "", -1, false)
	find := func(class string) *objNode {
		for i := range w.out {
			if w.out[i].class == class || (class == "$root" && w.out[i].class == "" && i == 0) {
				return &w.out[i]
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	root := find("$root")
	ev := find("evidence")
	gl := find("evidence.genesisLink")
	chk := find("evidence.check")
	ver := find("evidence.version")
	if root == nil || ev == nil || gl == nil || chk == nil || ver == nil || gl.kind != 'o' || ev.kind != 'o' || chk.kind != 'o' {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("the document has no evidence.genesisLink object")
	}
	good := string(doc[gl.vs:gl.ve])
	var link map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(good), &link); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	start, _ := link["start"].(string)
	anchor, _ := link["anchor"].(string)
	flip := func(h string) string {
		if h == "" {
			return "00"
		}
		c := h[0]
		if c == '0' {
			c = '1'
		} else {
			c = '0'
		}
		return string(c) + h[1:]
	}
	replace := func(n *objNode, text string) []ByteEdit { return []ByteEdit{{At: n.vs, Del: n.ve - n.vs, Ins: ins(text)}} }
	rename := func(to string) []ByteEdit { return []ByteEdit{{At: gl.ms + 1, Del: len("genesisLink"), Ins: ins(to)}} }
	del := func() ByteEdit { return ByteEdit{At: gl.delFrom, Del: gl.delTo - gl.delFrom} }
	member := func(key, val string) string { return `"` + key + `":` + val }
	// the member written before / after the good one (the edits are at the member's start and at its value's end)
	before := func(text string) []ByteEdit { return []ByteEdit{{At: gl.ms, Ins: ins(text + ",")}} }
	after := func(text string) []ByteEdit { return []ByteEdit{{At: gl.ve, Ins: ins("," + text)}} }
	var out []spellCase
	add := func(name string, edits []ByteEdit) { out = append(out, spellCase{name, edits}) }

	// the value
	add("delete", []ByteEdit{del()})
	for _, v := range []struct{ n, t string }{{"null", "null"}, {"empty-string", `""`}, {"empty-object", `{}`}, {"empty-array", `[]`}, {"number0", `0`}, {"false", `false`}, {"true", `true`}, {"string-00", `"00"`}, {"string-deadbeef", `"deadbeef"`}} {
		add(v.n, replace(gl, v.t))
	}
	add("obj-empty-fields", replace(gl, `{"start":"","anchor":"","entries":[]}`))
	add("obj-null-entries", replace(gl, fmt.Sprintf(`{"start":%q,"anchor":%q,"entries":null}`, start, anchor)))
	add("obj-null-step", replace(gl, fmt.Sprintf(`{"start":%q,"anchor":%q,"entries":[null]}`, start, anchor)))
	add("obj-no-steps-same-start", replace(gl, fmt.Sprintf(`{"start":%q,"anchor":%q}`, start, start)))
	altered := func(key, val string) string {
		c := map[string]any{}
		for k, v := range link {
			c[k] = v
		}
		c[key] = val
		b, _ := json.Marshal(c)
		return string(b)
	}
	add("obj-start-altered", replace(gl, altered("start", flip(start))))
	add("obj-anchor-altered", replace(gl, altered("anchor", flip(anchor))))

	// the name
	add("case-genesislink-only", rename("genesislink"))
	add("case-GenesisLink-only", rename("GenesisLink"))
	add("case-GENESISLINK-only", rename("GENESISLINK"))
	add("snake-genesis_link", rename("genesis_link"))
	add("trailing-space-key", rename("genesisLink "))

	// misplaced: the member taken out of evidence and written at the top of the document, or into evidence.check
	add("misplaced-top-level", []ByteEdit{del(), {At: root.closeAt, Ins: ins("," + member("genesisLink", good))}})
	add("misplaced-in-check", []ByteEdit{del(), {At: chk.closeAt, Ins: ins("," + member("genesisLink", good))}})

	// duplicates: the last value is the one Go keeps
	for _, d := range []struct{ n, key, t string }{{"dup-good-then-null", "genesisLink", "null"}, {"dup-good-then-empty-string", "genesisLink", `""`}, {"dup-good-then-empty-object", "genesisLink", `{}`}, {"dup-good-then-empty-array", "genesisLink", `[]`}, {"dup-good-then-GENESISLINK-null", "GENESISLINK", "null"}, {"dup-good-then-genesislink-empty-object", "genesislink", `{}`}} {
		add(d.n, after(member(d.key, d.t)))
	}
	for _, d := range []struct{ n, key, t string }{{"dup-null-then-good", "genesisLink", "null"}, {"dup-string-then-good", "genesisLink", `"x"`}, {"dup-empty-object-then-good", "genesisLink", `{}`}, {"dup-altered-then-good", "genesisLink", altered("start", flip(start))}, {"dup-GENESISLINK-null-then-good", "GENESISLINK", "null"}, {"dup-genesislink-altered-then-good", "genesislink", altered("anchor", flip(anchor))}} {
		add(d.n, before(member(d.key, d.t)))
	}
	add("dup-good-then-good", after(member("genesisLink", good)))
	add("dup-lower-good-then-upper-null", append(rename("genesislink"), ByteEdit{At: gl.ve, Ins: ins("," + member("GENESISLINK", "null"))}))

	// links: the same link taken out of genesisLink and given as the links member (or beside it)
	insEv := func(text string) ByteEdit { return ByteEdit{At: ev.closeAt, Ins: ins("," + text)} }
	add("links-null", []ByteEdit{del(), insEv(member("links", "null"))})
	add("links-empty-array", []ByteEdit{del(), insEv(member("links", "[]"))})
	add("links-one-good-link-no-genesis", []ByteEdit{del(), insEv(member("links", "["+good+"]"))})
	add("links-one-empty-object", []ByteEdit{del(), insEv(member("links", "[{}]"))})
	add("links-one-empty-object-with-genesis", []ByteEdit{insEv(member("links", "[{}]"))})
	add("links-one-good-link-with-genesis", []ByteEdit{insEv(member("links", "["+good+"]"))})

	// the version
	for _, v := range []struct{ n, t string }{{"version-null", "null"}, {"version-empty", `""`}, {"version-2.10", `"2.10"`}, {"version-2.1-space", `"2.1 "`}, {"version-2.0-with-members", `"2.0"`}} {
		add(v.n, replace(ver, v.t))
	}
	return out, nil
}

func genesisSpellCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "Every spelling of the evidence 2.1 genesis link member (the value, the name's case and form, a misplaced member, duplicate keys in both orders, the link given as links, the version) of every document that carries one, judged by VerifyPortable from the text: the offline walk requires the link of every 2.1 document and reads the member as encoding/json does."}
	bases, err := genesisBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sort.Strings(bases)
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStableCounting(raw, new(int), new(int))
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	byV := map[string]int{}
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		cs, err := spellCases(docs[bi])
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		for _, c := range cs {
			text := applyEdits(docs[bi], c.edits)
			lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
			ex, ok := judgeSweep(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
			if !ok {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s [%s] %s%s\n", bpath, c.name, lastPanic, lastFlaky)
				continue
			}
			byV[ex.V]++
			f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("genesisspell:%s:%s", bpath, c.name), Base: bi, Op: "genesisspell " + c.name, Edits: c.edits, Expect: ex})
		}
	}
	fmt.Printf("genesisspell: %d bases, %d cases %v, skipped %+v\n", len(bases), len(f.Cases), byV, f.Skipped)
	return writeJSON(filepath.Join(out, "bytes-cases-genesisspell.json.gz"), f)
}
